rules: Every value below is copied from the product's own Amazon listing page on the capture date, or left blank.
A blank value is never inferred from a sibling product, a review widget, or a competitor.

No price, availability, delivery date, deal, or coupon is stored or published anywhere on this site. Amazon's Program Policies section 2(b) permits showing price and availability only when Amazon serves that data; this site does not, so it shows none.
intended.* is the confirmation record: the ASIN this site intends to link to and the date that intent was recorded. observed.* is what the short link actually did when fetched. They are never merged.

products.name: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven

intended.source: Supplied short link link.amazon/B04G1MEwY (S16). The destination was resolved by fetching the link; the intent was recorded from the link the site owner supplied.

observed.resolved_status: HTTP 200, Amazon product page for ASIN B0CDY277D3
observed.note: The resolved URL carried query parameters (lv, btn_type, btn_ref, channelId, plpRedirect) but no visible tag= parameter in what was served to this session. Whether an Associates ID is attached is unverified — see Q-02.

capacity_title.value: 6 qt total, described as two independent 3 qt baskets

capacity_field.value: 6 liters (as printed in the listing's Capacity field)

dimensions.value: 13.38 in D x 11.81 in W x 10.63 in H

features.value: Sync Finish, Hi-Fry, 2-minute button, automatic shut-off, mute

temperature_range.note: The bullets begin a 'WIDE TEMPERATURE RANGE' claim but the numbers did not render in the captured page. Not published.

presets.note: No preset count stated on the listing.

dishwasher_safe_parts.value: Baskets described as nonstick and dishwasher safe

warranty.note: No manufacturer warranty period stated on the listing.

price.note: Deliberately not stored or shown (Program Policies 2(b), S02).

highlights: Two independent baskets, so a protein and a side can cook at once instead of in sequence.
Sync Finish is the feature that matters for two-basket cooking: it lines up the two timers to end together.
The footprint, 13.38 in deep by 11.81 in wide, is the number to measure your counter against before anything else.
watch_outs: The Capacity field says 6 liters while the title says 6 quarts. 6 US quarts is about 5.68 litres, so the field is not a straight conversion. Both are printed on the listing; neither is corrected here (F-01).
Two 3 qt baskets do not behave like one 6 qt basket. A 6 qt single-basket machine holds a whole chicken; two 3 qt drawers hold pieces.
The listing puts a paid Asurion protection plan next to the buy box. It is an add-on, not part of the product.
products.signal_summary: Published spec sheet, dated: dual-basket, 6 qt nominal capacity, 13.38 in counter depth. The listing's own capacity unit is inconsistent, so treat '6 qt' as nominal rather than measured.

observed.resolved_status: HTTP 200, Amazon product page for ASIN B09B7SB46R
observed.note: Resolved URL carried query parameters but no visible tag= parameter in what was served to this session. See Q-02.

type.value: Oven-style air fryer with French doors

capacity_title.value: 26 qt, described as suitable for 4-6 people, a 6 lb chicken or a 12 in pizza

capacity_field.value: 24.6 liters (as printed in the listing's Capacity field)

dimensions.value: 16.9 in D x 15.8 in W x 14.8 in H

features.value: Automatic shut-off, programmable, temperature control, timer; dual-speed fan; interior light; six cooking accessories included

preset_count.value: Conflicting: the title says 24 one-touch presets, a bullet says 25 cooking presets

warranty.note: No manufacturer warranty period stated on the listing.

highlights: 26 qt is a different class of machine from a 6 qt basket fryer; it is a countertop oven that also air fries.
French doors open outward instead of a drop-down door, which changes how much clearance you need in front of it and how you reach in.
The listing states it fits a 12 in pizza and rotisseries a 6 lb chicken — two concrete tests that a basket fryer at this price will not pass.
watch_outs: The preset count differs inside the same listing: 24 in the title, 25 in a bullet. It is not published here as a spec (F-02).
26 qt in the title against 24.6 liters in the field: 26 US quarts is about 24.6 litres, so these two do agree. Unlike P1, there is no unit conflict here.
17 in of counter depth is roughly half a metre. That is the largest footprint of the five products and the first thing to check.
products.signal_summary: Published spec sheet, dated: oven-style, 26 qt nominal, 16.9 in counter depth, six accessories. Preset count is inconsistent on the listing itself.

products.name: Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt TurboFry 4-in-1

observed.resolved_status: HTTP 200, Amazon product page for ASIN B08DKYBTPH (the 8-quart size variant)
observed.note: The listing offers 6 qt, 8 qt and 9 qt variants. The resolved page is the 8 qt variant. Resolved URL carried query parameters but no visible tag= parameter. See Q-02.

capacity_title.value: 8 qt (size variants also listed at 6 qt and 9 qt)

dimensions.value: 12.75 in D x 13.5 in W x 10 in H

colour.value: Stainless steel (a black variant is also listed)

features.value: TurboFry 4-in-1: air fry, bake, dehydrate, frozen; 450 F Hi-Fry option; automatic shut-off, LED shake reminder, programmable

presets.value: Four presets (French fries, chicken, meat, fish)

temperature_range.value: Hi-Fry option at 450 F described; full range not stated

dishwasher_safe_parts.value: Basket described as nonstick and dishwasher safe

warranty.note: No manufacturer warranty period stated on the listing.

badges_at_capture.value: Amazon's Choice; 3K+ bought in past month

highlights: One basket, 8 qt, 12.75 in deep — the simplest and shallowest of the three air fryers here.
Dehydrate is a real mode, not a preset label, so it can do jerky and dried fruit as well as frying.
A shake reminder and a 450 F Hi-Fry option cover the two things single-basket cooking usually gets wrong: uneven crisping and a ceiling too low to finish food.
watch_outs: The basket is one compartment. Two foods need either two batches or one mixed batch that cooks at the same rate.
8 qt is generous but shallow: 10 in tall, so a tall roast will not fit even though the volume looks large.
This ASIN is a multi-size listing. Confirm the size you receive; the link resolves to the 8 qt variant.
products.signal_summary: Published spec sheet, dated: single-basket, 8 qt, 12.75 in counter depth, four presets plus dehydrate and a 450 F Hi-Fry mode.

products.name: ThermoMaven 1 Sec Professional Digital Meat Thermometer

observed.resolved_status: HTTP 200, Amazon product page for ASIN B0DHZTCNR5
observed.note: The listing itself shows 'There is a newer model of this item' pointing to ASIN B0GL7Z4KP4 (F-03). Resolved URL carried query parameters but no visible tag= parameter. See Q-02.

accuracy_claim.value: plus or minus 0.5 F claimed; the listing states a NIST certification for that figure

certifications_listed.value: Specification Met field: NIST, NSF (seller-declared attribute)

water_resistance.value: IP67 stated in the title; body described as waterproof and rinse-clean

display.value: Digital LED, auto-rotating; movement-activated wake and sleep

dimensions.note: No product-dimensions field on the listing. Not published.

included.value: Thermometer, AAA battery, user manual, calibration certificate

rating_at_capture.note: No star rating was present on the page at capture.

highlights: One-second reading matters for thin food: a slow thermometer keeps the probe in long enough that the reading drifts.
IP67 and a wipe-clean body mean it can be rinsed rather than scrubbed around the screen.
It ships with a calibration certificate and an AAA battery, so it is usable the day it arrives — useful for checking against an ice bath.
watch_outs: The listing shows a newer model (B0GL7Z4KP4) in a same-colour family. The supplied link points at this ASIN, not the newer one (F-03).
There is no product-dimensions field, so probe length — the specification that decides whether it reaches the centre of a large roast — is unpublished here (F-04).
NIST and NSF appear in the seller's specification field. A certification body's mark was not independently verified (F-06, F-07).
products.signal_summary: Published spec sheet, dated: handheld instant-read, 1 s claimed, IP67, AAA. Probe length and physical size are absent from the listing.

products.name: CHEF iQ Sense Smart Wireless Meat Thermometer, 3 Probes

observed.resolved_status: HTTP 200, Amazon product page for ASIN B0DZFD6R9Z (3-probe size variant)
observed.note: The listing offers 1, 2, 3 and 4-probe variants. The resolved page is the 3-probe variant. Resolved URL carried query parameters but no visible tag= parameter. See Q-02.

type.value: Wireless multi-probe thermometer with a charging hub

probes.value: Three ultra-thin probes included; variants listed with 1, 2, 3 and 4 probes

sensors.value: Five sensors: four internal temperature sensors plus one ambient sensor

heat_resistance.value: Probes described as built to endure 1000 F

connectivity.value: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth; readings displayed in the CHEF iQ app

battery.value: Up to 50 hours on a full charge (stated)

certifications_listed.value: Specification Met field lists about twenty schemes including FDA, ISO 13485, HACCP (seller-declared attribute)

water_resistance.value: Probes described as waterproof and dishwasher safe

dimensions.note: No product-dimensions field on the listing. Not published.

warranty.value: Two-year assurance from CHEF iQ, stated in a bullet

included.value: Three probes and a smart hub

highlights: Three probes means three different proteins can be tracked to three different targets in the same cook.
The ambient sensor reads oven or grill temperature alongside the food, which is the difference between 'cook 20 minutes' and 'cook until the food is at target'.
App-based readings with a stated unlimited range over Wi-Fi are what you want if the smoker is outside and you are not.
A stated two-year assurance and dishwasher-safe probes lower the running cost of owning it.
watch_outs: It is app-dependent. The listing's display type is 'App', so a phone and a Wi-Fi network are part of the product, not accessories.
The specification field lists about twenty certification schemes; that is a seller-populated attribute and not a substitute for a certificate you can read (F-06).
Probe length and hub size are not published on the listing (F-04).
This is the priciest class of product in the set; the extra cost buys connectivity and probes, not accuracy versus a good instant-read.
products.signal_summary: Published spec sheet, dated: wireless, three probes, five sensors, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, 1000 F heat-safe probes, two-year assurance. Physical size not published.
